subject: feat(install): modular installer with deploy plugins, AI wizard pipeline, scrape v2, and test suite (#111)
body:
* fix(install): generate correct consumer site for jekyll-theme-zer0 gem

Fixes the installer so scaffolded sites build and serve using the
published jekyll-theme-zer0 gem via Docker without manual edits.

Changes:
- install.sh: add generate_consumer_dockerfile() — single-stage
  ruby:3.3-slim image that installs the gem from RubyGems (no
  gemspec/lib references, adds libssl-dev + pkg-config for openssl)
- install.sh: install_docker_files() calls generate_consumer_dockerfile
  instead of copying the dev Dockerfile from the source repo
- install.sh: update_docker_compose_config() removes target:dev-test,
  simplifies command, removes bundle_cache volume + named-volume block,
  removes BUNDLE_PATH env var (gems bake into image at system path,
  BUNDLE_PATH=/usr/local/bundle redirected Bundler to an empty dir)
- install.sh: optimize_development_config() enables theme:jekyll-theme-zer0
  and jekyll-include-cache plugin in _config_dev.yml
- install.sh: create_site_gemfile() uses full template for Docker/full
  installs instead of the macOS-compat fallback; macOS compat now
  only triggers for minimal mode
- templates/config/Gemfile.full.template: switch from github-pages to
  jekyll-theme-zer0 + jekyll-include-cache + jekyll ~> 4.3
- templates/config/Gemfile.macos.template: add jekyll-include-cache
- templates/config/Gemfile.minimal.template: add jekyll-include-cache
- _includes/components/nav-overview.html: new — navigation summary
  cards used by pages/_about/settings/navigatio…
